title: A Crown for the Sigil Anew
author: S. M. Villalobos
blurb: Kestrel Okonkwo, a beast-speaker hiding a forbidden gift, keeps the ledgers of a guild that trades in impossible things. But when a dying stranger presses a map into unwilling hands, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must find the door out of a country that no longer exists before the last dragon-fire gutters out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
